about.zmksDescription: ZMKs Studio is a community build based on ZMK Studio. It keeps the upstream ZMK Studio keymap editing workflow and adds this fork's UI, lighting, localization, and desktop client improvements. The original ZMK Studio project and ZMK contributors remain the foundation of this work.

flavorDesc.holdPreferred: Fires the hold as soon as the term passes or another key is pressed. Best for modifiers.
flavorDesc.balanced: If you press and release another key while holding, it resolves to a hold; release this key first and it taps. Fits how most modifiers are used.
flavorDesc.tapPreferred: Only holds if you truly keep it pressed past the term. Fewest typing misfires.
flavorDesc.tapUnlessInterrupted: Taps by default, holds only when interrupted by another key.

desc.retroTap: Held past the term without pressing another key? Still send the tap on release.
desc.holdWhileUndecided: Activate the hold immediately while deciding instead of waiting. Useful for mouse modifiers.
desc.holdWhileUndecidedLinger: Keep the hold active until just after the tap is sent. Only matters with Immediate Hold.
desc.holdTriggerOnRelease: Delay the positional hold decision until the key is released.
desc.quickTapMs: Press the key again within this time after a tap to tap again — e.g. tap-then-hold Backspace to repeat.
desc.requirePriorIdleMs: If you pressed another key within this time, resolve to a tap — avoids accidental holds while typing fast.

unlockPanel.title: Unlock shortcut
unlockPanel.desc: The keyboard locks itself so a web page can't change your keymap without you. Unlocking is always a physical action — Studio cannot do it remotely.
unlockPanel.protectedHint: Firmware reserves this slot for unlocking, so it can't be repointed at another behavior.
unlockPanel.noneDesc: This firmware exposes no studio unlock binding. Once the keyboard locks, Studio won't be able to edit it again — reflash before locking it.
unlockPanel.changeHint: You'll be asked to perform the new gesture before it replaces the current one, and the keyboard stays unlocked throughout.
unlockPanel.noSpareSlot: Setting up a combo shortcut needs one free combo slot to confirm the gesture with. Free a slot on the Combos page first.
unlockPanel.createHint: Sets up a key combination that unlocks the keyboard, alongside the existing unlock key. You'll be asked to perform it once before it's saved.

unlockChange.title: Change unlock shortcut
unlockChange.pickHint: Click the keys the shortcut should use — at least two, pressed together.
unlockChange.noLayout: No physical layout reported, so keys can't be picked.
unlockChange.warnConflict: Another combo already uses exactly these keys. Pick a different set.
unlockChange.warnTyping: These are all ordinary keys, so the chord could fire while typing. Studio will require a brief pause before it counts — including one layer or modifier key is safer.
unlockChange.pressHint: Your current shortcut is untouched until this one is confirmed, and the keyboard stays unlocked throughout — so nothing is at risk if it doesn't work.
unlockChange.confirmedHint: The keyboard produced the test keystroke, so this gesture works. Apply it as the unlock shortcut?
unlockChange.timeoutSafe: You can apply without confirmation; this keyboard still has another way to unlock.
unlockChange.timeoutRisky: Applying without confirmation means that if the gesture doesn't work, the keyboard can't be edited again without reflashing.
unlockChange.doneHint: It's live right now, but only in memory — write it to the keyboard or it's gone at the next power cycle.
unlockChange.priorIdleApplied: A brief pause is now required before the chord counts, so it can't fire while typing.
unlockChange.warnUnverified: Applied without confirmation — test it before you let the keyboard lock.
unlockChange.errArm: Couldn't set up the test. Nothing was changed.
unlockChange.errCommit: Writing the new shortcut failed. Your old one still works.
unlockChange.errNoKeyPress: This firmware has no Key Press behavior, so the gesture can't be tested.
unlockChange.timeoutNoInput: No keystrokes are reaching Studio at all. Make sure this window has focus and that the keyboard is typing into this computer.
unlockChange.tryAnotherProbe: Retry with a different test key
unlockChange.timeoutSwallowed: If pressing them together shows nothing at all, the combo IS firing — ZMK swallows the keys it consumes and sends the test key instead, so only the test key is going missing. Try a different one. (Seeing the keys individually just means the chord didn't complete.)
unlockChange.errStoredBehavior: Firmware accepted the test but didn't store the test keystroke on the slot. That's why the chord swallows keys and emits nothing — the trigger landed and the behavior didn't. This needs a firmware fix; the read-back above is the evidence.
unlockChange.errStoredPositions: Firmware accepted the test but stored different trigger keys, so this device isn't taking the write as sent.
unlockChange.pickHintCreate: Your existing unlock key stays as it is, so this is purely an addition.
unlockChange.warnOverlap: These keys are also used by another combo
unlockChange.warnOverlapHint: Overlapping combos compete, and the other one may win — which makes the test below look like it failed for no reason.
unlockChange.warnSameAsCurrent: That's the shortcut already in use, so there's nothing to confirm. Pick different keys — or cancel to keep it as it is.
unlockChange.warnShadowedByUnlock: These keys overlap your current unlock shortcut, which stays live during the test. It would win the chord and unlock instead of producing the test keystroke, so the test can't confirm anything. Pick keys it doesn't share.
unlockChange.savedOk: Written to the keyboard — firmware reports the shortcut on the slot.
unlockChange.savedVerifyHint: Studio can't see storage, only the live slot. Worth unplugging the keyboard and reconnecting once to confirm it stuck — while your old unlock method still works.
unlockChange.savedFailed: The save didn't take — firmware doesn't report the shortcut on the slot afterwards. Don't let this keyboard lock until you've used your existing unlock method to check it.
